entries.hook: Congress decides whether crypto gets one federal rulebook.
entries.event_plain: the Clarity Act (crypto market-structure law) becomes law before 2028

market.question: Will a crypto market structure bill become law before Jan 1, 2028?
market.rules_summary: Yes if a bill that sets a comprehensive digital-asset framework, splits SEC/CFTC authority and defines when tokens are securities or commodities becomes law before Jan 1, 2028. Stablecoin-only, tax-only bills and agency rules do not count.

election.note: Policy book: Republican House 0.05 vs Democratic House 0; Senate control 0.05 either way

impact.formula: transaction revenue $3,802.5M (consumer $3,322.8M + institutional $479.7M, FY2025) x 10% lift from a federal rulebook (0-20%) x 86% contribution margin (1 - transaction expense $1,020.2M / revenue $7,181.3M) = $327M; + staking: net staking $249.9M ($677.4M - $427.5M rewards fees) x 84% US x ~20% of US population in the 5 states that paused staking (CA, NJ, SC, WI, MD) = $42M; total ~$370M a year

entries.hook: A federal ban on sports prediction markets would cut Coinbase's newest business.

market.question: Law banning sports prediction markets enacted in 2026?
market.rules_summary: Yes if a bill that bars CFTC-regulated prediction markets from offering sports contracts, or puts them under state gambling law, is signed into law (or passes over a veto) by Dec 31, 2026.
